Securities and Exchange Commission v. Exampla Holdings plc, et al.

LR-99901
2099-03-01
Litigation Release
Exampla Holdings plc
Jordan Example

The Securities and Exchange Commission today announced that on February 27, 2099 it filed settled charges against Exampla Holdings plc (CIK No. 0009999101) and its former finance director Jordan Example in the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York.

Securities and Exchange Commission v. Exampla Holdings plc, et al., Civil Action No. 1:99-cv-00901 (S.D.N.Y.).

The SEC's complaint alleges that Exampla Holdings plc overstated revenue in 2097 and 2098 in violation of Section 17(a) of the Securities Act of 1933 and Section 10(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 10b-5 thereunder.

Without admitting or denying the allegations in the complaint, Exampla Holdings plc consented to the entry of a final judgment that permanently enjoins it from violating Section 10(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and orders it to pay disgorgement of $1,200,000, prejudgment interest of $85,000 and a civil penalty of $2,500,000.

Jordan Example consented to the entry of a final judgment that orders a civil penalty of $50,000.

The court entered a final judgment against Exampla Holdings plc on April 3, 2099.
